exposure: birth at a tertiary maternity unit
Planned birth location (freestanding midwifery unit or tertiary maternity unit)
outcome: Admission to special care nursery or neonatal intensive care
cohort: Two groups of women with low-risk singleton pregnancies: 260 who planned to give birth at a freestanding midwifery unit but transferred to a tertiary maternity unit, and 3157 who planned to give birth at a tertiary maternity unit
finding: Women planning birth at freestanding midwifery units who transferred during the intrapartum/postnatal period had a lower cesarean section rate compared to those planning birth at tertiary units, while other outcomes were comparable.
mod_finding: Women initially planning birth at freestanding midwifery units had a lower rate of caesarean sections compared to those who planned births at tertiary units.
